jacobian.note: central differences; absolute error tolerance 1e-6 (entries are O(1e-3..1))

noise.note: z = (empirical - model)/standard error; |C_z| > 4 counts as a mismatch in either direction. noise_plus_slip adds the unmodelled heavy-tailed slip (spin only); the gate is chi2_1 99.9%.

linearisation.note: consistent propagation <=> expected_pose_nees ~ 3, whitened eig ~ 1; no measurement update

observability.note: linear information ignoring C (shared gyro noise): an optimistic bound on identifiability
